name: C-02-U universal L-track floor bracket
description: The C-02-U universal floor bracket: one flat laser-cut plate that bolts a module to L-track, replacing the per-vehicle bracket variants. Laid flat on the XY plane with thickness in Z, centred on the origin in X and Y. All four vertical corners rounded on a generous radius. Three mounting holes evenly spaced along the long centreline, plus one smaller locating pin hole offset from the centreline. Every hole goes fully through.
notes: Mounting holes dia 0.281 at (-2.000, 0), (0.000, 0) and (+2.000, 0). Locating pin hole dia 0.266 at (+1.000, +0.625). Corner radius is 0.375, larger than the plate parts.
